hed: Zelenskyy: energy-strike pause only if Russia truly stops; Trump claimed deal Monday
dek: Into Tuesday morning, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s Monday condition still framed the energy-infrastructure dispute: Kyiv will pause strikes on Russian energy and critical infrastructure only if partners can ensure Moscow genuinely stops hitting Ukraine’s electricity, other energy sites, critical infrastructure, and food routes. President Trump had posted Monday that Ukraine and Russia agreed not to hit energy targets; neither Kyiv nor Moscow confirmed a sealed deal. AAA’s national diesel average rose to a record $6.2694 on Tuesday.

byline: Event summary from public reporting and named outlets

cl.body: The Guardian’s Tuesday Ukraine briefing, PBS/AP’s Monday Zelenskyy write-through, and Politico Europe cast Trump’s purported energy ceasefire as unconfirmed — Zelenskyy said he was not sure Russia intends to abide and conditioned any pause on partners verifying a real Russian halt, while fighting and near-border drone pressure continued overnight.

cr.body: New York Post and Washington Examiner Monday accounts plus AAA’s Tuesday diesel print frame Trump’s energy-target claim against a record $6.27 U.S. diesel average — casting Ukrainian refinery strikes as a diesel-supply driver Trump wants paused even as Zelenskyy insists on verified Russian reciprocity before Kyiv stands down.

stack_blurb: Zelenskyy conditions reciprocal energy pause; Trump claimed agreement; diesel record.
seo_description: Trump says Ukraine and Russia agreed to halt energy strikes as U.S. diesel hits a record; Zelenskyy conditions any pause on verified Russian reciprocity.
